item.title: A scorecard for the AI age
item.description: Sarah Friar, CFO of OpenaAI, introduces a practical AI scorecard to measure ROI through useful work, cost per successful task, dependability, and return on compute. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/a-scorecard-for-the-ai-age

item.title: Why teens deserve access to safe AI
item.description: Learn how OpenAI is making ChatGPT safer for teens with age-appropriate protections, learning tools, parental controls, and expert partnerships. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/why-teens-deserve-access-safe-ai

item.title: How Cars24 scales conversations and builds faster with OpenAI
item.description: Cars24 uses OpenAI-powered voice and chat agents to handle 1M+ monthly conversation minutes, recover 12% of lost leads, and bring agentic workflows to teams across the company. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/cars24

item.title: The US is advancing AI safety through state and federal action
item.description: OpenAI outlines a “reverse federalism” approach to AI governance, where state laws help build a national framework for safe, democratic AI. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/advancing-ai-safety-through-state-and-federal-action

item.title: GPT-Red: Unlocking Self-Improvement for Robustness
item.description: Explore GPT-Red, OpenAI’s automated red teaming system that uses self-play to improve AI safety, alignment, and prompt injection robustness. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/unlocking-self-improvement-gpt-red

item.title: How to manage AI investments in the agentic era
